entities.name: Siren
entities.description: A creature type of humanoid sea creatures, typically female and winged, who lure mariners to destruction with seductive singing.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane whose sirens have avian features, can fly, and include several males.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A Greek-inspired plane whose sirens resemble classical Hellenic ones with feathered wings.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: A pirate faction on Ixalan whose crews include sirens.

entities.name: Malcolm Lee
entities.description: A male siren of Ixalan, the most notable of them, with senses keen enough to hear his companions' heartbeats.

entities.name: Maeve, Insidious Singer
entities.description: A siren from an unknown plane whose lower half is like an octopus, said to sing a haunting song that lures ships into rocks.

entities.name: Threnody Singer
entities.description: A kind of siren that exists in the Underworld of Theros, luring the souls of the dead.

events.summary: Sirens of Ixalan are described as mercurial creatures who serve on Brazen Coalition crews, in at least one case as captain.
events.quote: They are mercurial creatures who can turn in an instant from loving to murderous

events.summary: On Ixalan, a ship's carpenter adds a cosmium gem to a siren figurehead, animating it into an artificial flying siren.
events.quote: a ship's carpenter added a cosmium gem to their siren figurehead, which animated it into an artificial flying siren

relations.note: Some Ixalan sirens are members of the Coalition.
relations.quote: The Ixalan block depicted some new Sirens as members of the Brazen Coalition

relations.note: Malcolm is a male siren of Ixalan.
relations.quote: Uniquely, several sirens are male, the most notable being Malcolm
